- [FACT] User has chests of drawers and filing cabinets that need to be moved.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is generally recommended to empty both chests of drawers and filing cabinets before moving them.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Moving full chests of drawers can make them difficult to move safely.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There is a risk of damaging the structure of the chest of drawers if moved full.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Filing cabinets can also be very heavy when full of paperwork or other items.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Moving full filing cabinets can be difficult, especially in tight spaces like stairs or narrow hallways.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Leaving paperwork in filing cabinets during a move risks losing or damaging them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is particularly important to secure confidential or sensitive documents during a move.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, it is best to empty both chests of drawers and filing cabinets before moving them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Emptying the furniture will make them lighter and easier to move.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Emptying the furniture helps prevent damage to the furniture or the items inside.
